description: This file contains styling functions for the DashboardNavbar component in a React project, defining styles for navbar layout, container, row, icon button, and mobile menu using theme properties.

methods.name: navbar
methods.description: Generates style object for the navbar component based on theme and ownerState.

methods.name: navbarContainer
methods.description: Defines styles for the navbar container layout responsive to breakpoints.

methods.name: navbarRow
methods.description: Defines styles for the navbar row layout, adjusting for 'isMini' state and breakpoints.

methods.name: navbarIconButton
methods.description: Styles for icon buttons in the navbar, adjusting icon size and typography display based on breakpoints.

methods.name: navbarMobileMenu
methods.description: Styles for the mobile menu toggle, showing or hiding based on breakpoints.
